d: Chhath Puja 2026 : lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath puja ko lekar rajdhani patna men utsah charam par hai... chhath puja ke dusre din yani kharna ke mauke par patna ke ghaton par shraddhaluon ki bhir umar rahi hai... ghaton par chhath ki taiyariyon aur puja ko lekar raunak dekhne ko mil rahi hai... kharna ke sath hi vrati karib 36 ghante ke nirjala upvas ki shuruaat karte hain.... iske bad 15 navanbar ko dubte sury ko sandhya arghy aur 16 navanbar ko ugte sury ko usha arghy diya jaega.... patna ke ghaton par kaisi hai chhath ki raunak?
